recordings.question: Where is the Senior Controls Engineer pipeline losing candidates, and why?

result.answer:
The Senior Controls Engineer pipeline loses most of its candidates **after the onsite, while they wait for a decision**. Most of them go on to accept offers from other companies.

**1. Onsite to Offer: the main leak**
- 7 candidates have left the Onsite stage. Only 1 moved on to an offer and 6 were lost. That is a pass rate of 14.3%, compared with 66.7% on your other roles.
- Why they left:
  - 5 withdrew because they accepted another offer [APP-043] [APP-044] [APP-045] [APP-048] [APP-051].
  - Only 1 was turned down by the interview panel [APP-049].
- The likely cause is slow decisions. Candidates who left waited a median of 13.3 days after their last interview and 15.1 days in the stage overall. The Technical stage has a median wait of 3.1 days.
- This isn't caused by any one source. Candidates from Agency, Careers site, Job board and LinkedIn all had a 0% pass rate at this stage. The one Referral who left the stage got the only offer.

**2. Recruiter Screen to Technical: a smaller leak**
- The pass rate is 71.4%, close to the 68.0% on your other roles. 6 candidates were lost:
  - 4 because their experience didn't match the must-haves [APP-041] [APP-047] [APP-052] [APP-057]
  - 1 because they weren't aligned on the role's scope [APP-055]
  - 1 who lost interest after the screen [APP-046]
- Agency candidates account for most of these losses. Only 28.6% of the 7 Agency candidates who left this stage moved on. Careers site and Referral candidates all moved on.

**Stages that are healthy**

| Stage | This role | Other roles | Lost here |
|---|---|---|---|
| Applied | 92.6% | 76.7% | 2, failed must-haves [APP-050] [APP-053] |
| Technical | 90.9% | 67.9% | 1, didn't meet the technical bar [APP-042] |

**Candidates at risk right now**
The 3 candidates still at Onsite are all flagged as overdue: they've been in the same stage for more than 7 days. Sam Rivera owns all three:

| Candidate | Days overdue | Evidence |

| Emerson Everly | 10.4 | [APP-060] [EV-0153] |

| Lane Thistlewood | 3.5 | [APP-063] [EV-0165] |

This is the same pattern that came before the last 5 withdrawals.

**What's missing from this analysis:** I haven't opened the individual scorecards or emails, so I can't tell why the decisions after onsites are slow. Possible causes include late scorecards, the panel's schedule, or approvals.

**Possible next steps:** have people decide faster after onsites, starting with the three candidates above. Also consider tightening how agency candidates are screened against the must-haves.
